profile.headline: Software Engineer at Equifax
profile.summary: I'm a full-stack software engineer with over 7 years of experience working with Java, Angular, Spring Boot, and cloud platforms. I leverage my Master’s in Cybersecurity and Bachelor’s in Computer Engineering to build scalable and secure applications. In my current role, I've delivered major projects including cloud application migrations, modern front and back-end features, and high-impact engineering initiatives. I’m passionate about reliable architectures, strong test coverage, and creating software solutions that are both resilient and efficient.

projects.title: Capstone in Cybersecurity Practicum
projects.description: The team is developing and securing a software application that peers will test and attack as part of a cybersecurity project. The team will also work on identifying and exploiting vulnerabilities in peer applications to simulate real-world offensive and defensive security scenarios.

projects.title: Machine Learning Analysis of Network Attacks
projects.description: Analyzed network traffic data to identify various attack patterns and reconnaissance techniques. Trained a neural network using multiple datasets featuring Botnet, Man-in-the-Middle (MitM), and Denial of Service (DoS) attacks. Developed a model capable of accurately detecting when an attack was occurring in real time.
